name: SPAN 6404
title: Special Topics in Nineteenth-Century Spanish-American Literature and Cultural Production
description: Nineteenth century Spanish-American cultural production from Independence to the end of the nineteenth century. Emphasis on the interaction of literature and social thought, on the relations between literature and other forms of art, or on the role of artistic and intellectual practices in shaping the new nations. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
